title: Khamyang: An Endangered Language of Assam (Sociolinguistic and Grammatical Documentation)
author: Dr. Biswajit Das
description: Comprehensive sociolinguistic profile and grammatical documentation of Tai Khamyang based on direct linguistic fieldwork at Pawaimukh village in Tinsukia district, detailing phonological structure, pronominal system, syntax, endangerment factors, and core vocabulary.

sentences.lik_tai: ၵဝ် ၵိၼ် ၶဝ်ႈ
sentences.speaker: Elder Informant (Pawaimukh)
sentences.notes: Canonical SVO sentence pattern documented by Das (Section 4.1).

sentences.lik_tai: မႂ်း ၵိၼ် ၶဝ်ႈ ႁိုဝ်
sentences.speaker: Elder Informant (Pawaimukh)
sentences.notes: Interrogative construction with final particle hü.

sentences.free_translation_en: We are going to Pawaimukh village.

sentences.notes: Pawaimukh as the last active speaking village.
